scripts.preinstall: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); ['package-lock.json', 'yarn.lock'].forEach(f => { try { fs.unlinkSync(f) } catch {} }); const userAgent = process.env.npm_config_user_agent || ''; const execPath = process.env.npm_execpath || process.env.npm_config_user_agent || ''; if (!userAgent.includes('pnpm') && !execPath.includes('pnpm')) { console.error('Use pnpm instead'); process.exit(1) }"
scripts.install-python: .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel && .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
